sloka: द्वाःस्थैरावेदितं तस्य रामायागमनं पुनः ।श्रुत्वैव चापि रामस्तं प्राप्तं शङ्कान्वितोऽभवत् ॥२-४-५॥
transliteration: dvāḥsthairāveditaṁ tasya rāmāyāgamanaṁ punaḥ ।śrutvaiva cāpi rāmastaṁ prāptaṁ śaṅkānvito'bhavat ॥2-4-5॥

translations.english: The doorkeepers informed Rama of Sumantra's arrival. As soon as he learnt that Sumantra was back again, Rama was filled with apprehensions.
